Developer Guide
If you are new to using nbdev here are some useful pointers to get you started.

Install nbedev_test in Development mode
# make sure nbedev_test package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to nbedev_test
$ nbdev_prepare

title: nbedev_test
text:
Usage

Installation
Install latest from the GitHub repository:
$ pip install git+https://github.com/schneider-clarify/nbedev_test.git
or from conda
$ conda install -c schneider-clarify nbedev_test
or from pypi
$ pip install nbedev_test


Documentation
Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub repository’s pages. Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on conda and pypi respectively.
